name: tech.aspid.fasttools
description: Unity tools to cut boilerplate — source-generated ProfilerMarkers, serializable type/enum systems, SerializeReference tooling and a fluent UIToolkit API.

samples.description: A character walking over surface tiles: EnumValues<TEnum, TValue> on a palette asset, EnumValues<TValue> with a [Flags] enum picked in the Inspector, default values and the flags lookup rules in action. Needs the built-in Physics module. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/enum-values

An enemy spawner storing three System.Types: SerializableMonoScript<T> (rename-safe), SerializableType<T> with [TypeSelectorDisplay] candidates, a member-referenced [TypeSelector] and ComponentTypeSelector to swap a component in place. The scene's colliders need the built-in Physics module. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/types

A turret firing polymorphic [SerializeReference] weapons at a dummy: the [TypeSelector] picker on single fields, lists, narrowed, nested and generic fields, plus deliberately broken assets for Fix, Smart Fix, Migrate all and the References tabs, and an IMGUI inspector. The scene's colliders need the built-in Physics module. With Build / CI gate on Fail, the broken assets stop a build: repair them, delete the sample or add its folder to Excluded scan folders. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/serialize-references

An editor window built in code: fluent VisualElement extensions, ListView and binding, SerializedProperty setters, GetDisplayName, AddOpenScriptCommand and TypeSelectorWindow as a public API. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/editor-tools

A flock simulation with this.Marker() around each phase: the generated marker tree in the Profiler, per-iteration markers, markers in plain classes and local functions. Needs the built-in Physics module. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/profiler-markers
